subject.title: Fork-per-issue from one warmed repo box

question: Should Clownfish adopt a prepared-workspace lease abstraction with isolated per-issue forks, and if so which runtime and safety guarantees are part of the supported contract?
rationale: The issue proposes a new execution architecture and optional external runtime integration; current evidence does not establish a repository-approved provider, fallback policy, or isolation boundary that an implementation can safely assume.

options.title: Adopt a runtime-neutral lease design
options.body: Specify the warm, fork, cleanup, capacity, and fallback contract first, then implement one provider behind it.

options.title: Adopt a specific provider now
options.body: Choose mitos or a Crabbox primitive as the supported runtime and accept its operational dependency and support surface.

options.title: Keep fresh provisioning
options.body: Retain the existing per-worker setup model until measured scale demand justifies a new execution architecture.

recommendation.title: Adopt a runtime-neutral lease design
recommendation.body: Specify the warm, fork, cleanup, capacity, and fallback contract first, then implement one provider behind it.

likelyOwner.reason: The identified merged history shows the closest current ownership signal for parallel worker execution and worker operational paths.
